changelog: New spoken-punctuation signs: with Spoken Punctuation on, say 'yen sign' (or 'ইয়েন চিহ্ন') while dictating and ¥ appears before the amount ('price yen sign 500' → 'price ¥500'), and say 'cent sign' (or 'সেন্ট চিহ্ন') and ¢ attaches to the amount ('fifty cent sign' → 'fifty¢') — completing the currency set alongside $, ৳, ₹, € and £ instead of typing ¥ or ¢ by hand. A bare 'yen' or 'cent' still types as a word. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
